name: aurora-text
title: Aurora Text
description: A span of text filled with a sliding pink-to-blue gradient that keeps drifting sideways, so a single word in a headline keeps catching the light.
use: One word in a headline should stand out with a moving colour highlight.
avoid: Body copy or long text; the cycling gradient distracts and hurts readability.
a11y: The visual copy is hidden from assistive tech with a screen-reader duplicate, but the loop ignores reduced-motion. (keyboard: n-a, labels: good, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A bold sans-serif heading on black made of three words. The first and last words are plain white, while the middle word is filled edge to edge with a pink, purple and blue gradient.
behaves: The gradient slides slowly along the word and wraps around, so the pink, purple and blue bands keep travelling across the letters. It repeats without stopping.
customise: Pass the word as children and set colors or speed; the gradient angle and the keyframe animation live in the source.
weight: light: A single text span with a repeating CSS background gradient.
